nora (People Ops): leaving this thread for quick follow-ups from today's all-hands about hybrid/workspace/offsite changes. Short Qs welcome! :wave:

kai (Eng): Is the new offsite per-person cap live now or starts next quarter?
drew (PM): same Q re: approval flow >$5k.
sam (Finance): caps kick in next quarter (Apr 1). Approvals unchanged: manager + finance for events >$5k. We'll post a budget template. :memo:

ops-bot: https://intranet.redwood/policies/travel-hybrid (policy draft)

kai (Eng): desk booking: any change to 2-week window? some teams need more flexibility.
nora (People Ops): piloting a rolling 5-day window at two hubs in May. Signups next week; we'll invite teams to opt in.
lia (HR): accessibility reminder: vendors must confirm at least one low-sensory option and non-alc beverages for evening events. Add this to vendor briefs.
drew (PM): visa letter turnaround? urgent candidate next week.
sam (Finance): standard 3 business days after request + manager ok. Mark subject "visa - expedite" for faster handling.
nora (People Ops): thanks all. We'll summarize in #announcements and update the policy page. DM @people-ops for exceptions. :white_check_mark:
